About.title: Good food, less waiting
About.subtitle: Spot connects hungry people with the restaurants of Armenia — and gives those restaurants simple tools to serve them well.

story.title: Why we built Spot
story.p1: We love going out to eat, but too often the evening goes to waiting: for a free table, for the menu, for the waiter, for the bill. Restaurants feel the same pain from the other side — paper orders, phone bookings and no time to look at the numbers.
story.p2: Spot puts the whole visit in one simple app. Guests find a place, book, order from the table and pay. Restaurants get a dashboard for the menu, orders, kitchen, reservations and bills — made for local businesses, in Armenian and English.

simple.title: Simple
simple.text: If a guest or a waiter needs instructions, we haven't done our job. Every screen is built for a phone and a busy evening.

local.title: Local
local.text: Made in Armenia for Armenian restaurants: Armenian first, prices in dram, and support that answers in your language.

fair.title: Fair
fair.text: Reviews come only from real visits, prices are always the restaurant's own, and your data stays yours.

guests.title: Guests
guests.text: Anyone who wants to find a good place, skip the queue and enjoy the meal. No app to install — it works in the browser.

restaurants.title: Restaurants, cafés and bars
restaurants.text: From a small coffee shop to a restaurant with several branches: one account, all locations, the whole team.

cta.title: Let's talk
cta.text: Questions, ideas or want to partner with us? We read every message.

Faq.title: Questions & answers
Faq.subtitle: Quick answers for guests and restaurants.

account.q: Do I need an account or an app?
account.a: No. Scan the QR code and order in your browser. An account is optional — it keeps your bookings, favourites and reviews in one place.

qr.q: How does ordering from the table work?
qr.a: Each table has its own QR code. Scan it with your phone camera, choose dishes from the menu and send the order. The kitchen and your waiter see it at once.

pay.a: Open your bill at any time from the table page. Depending on the restaurant, you can pay online or to the waiter by card or cash.

split.a: Yes. Each guest can pay for their own items, or you can split the total in equal parts.

reserve.q: How do I book a table?
reserve.a: Open the restaurant's page, press "Reserve a table", choose the date, time and number of people. You'll get a confirmation, and you can cancel from your bookings.

review.a: Only people who really visited — after a completed booking or a table visit. That keeps the reviews honest.

cost.a: Spot is free for the first year. We'll announce pricing well in advance, before any charges start.

start.a: Create an account, add your restaurant and its locations, build the menu and print the table QR codes. After a quick review by our team, your restaurant goes live.

pos.q: Does it work with our POS system?
pos.a: Spot can send orders to your cash register system. 1C is supported now and more systems are on the way — contact us to discuss yours.

staff.q: Can my whole team use it?
staff.a: Yes. Invite managers, waiters, kitchen staff and cashiers — each role sees only what it needs.

payouts.q: Who sets the prices and menu?
payouts.a: You do. Prices, dishes and availability are always yours, and orders keep the price the guest saw.

languages.a: Armenian and English, for both guests and staff. Guests can switch the language at any time.

Faq.more: Still have a question? <link>Write to us</link>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {company} ("Spot", "we") collects when you use Spot, why, and what you can do about it.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Spot is operated by {company}. For any privacy question or request, write to {email}.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
• Account data: name, email, phone (optional) and preferred language.
• Visit data: reservations, orders, bills and reviews you make.
• Technical data: device and browser type, IP address and the pages you open, to keep the service safe and working.
• Messages you send us through the contact form.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To run the service (bookings, orders, bills), to send you confirmations and notifications, to prevent fraud and abuse, to answer your messages, and to improve Spot using aggregated statistics. We do not sell your personal data.

restaurants.title: What restaurants see
restaurants.body: When you book or order, the restaurant receives what it needs to serve you: your name, party size, contact details for the booking, and your orders. Each restaurant sees only its own guests. Restaurants can also rate you as a guest after a visit (stars and a short comment). Only that restaurant's team and you can see it — you'll find it in your profile; other restaurants never do.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Online payments are processed by a licensed payment provider. Spot never sees or stores your full card number.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only the cookies needed to sign you in, remember your table and language, and keep the service secure. We don't use advertising cookies.

keep.title: How long we keep data
keep.body: We keep account data while your account exists. Financial records (orders, bills, payments) are kept as long as the law requires, even after an account is closed.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see and change your profile in your account, ask us for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, or withdraw consent — write to {email}. You may also complain to the personal data protection authority of Armenia.

children.title: Children
children.body: Spot is not intended for children under 16 to create accounts on their own.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy. We'll show the new date at the top, and tell you about important changes in the app or by email.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Spot, the service operated by {company}. By using Spot you agree to them.

accept.title: The service
accept.body: Spot helps guests find restaurants, book tables, order and pay, and helps restaurants manage their menu, orders, reservations and bills. Spot is a platform: the food and the service at the table are provided by the restaurant.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Give true information and keep your password safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

guests.title: Guests
guests.body: Orders and bookings are agreements between you and the restaurant. Please come on time or cancel a booking you can't keep. Deposits and cancellations follow the rules the restaurant shows when you book.

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.body: Restaurants are responsible for their menu, prices, availability, food quality and legal requirements such as receipts and taxes. Prices shown on Spot must match the prices charged in the restaurant.

payments.title: Prices and payments
payments.body: Prices are set by the restaurant and shown in Armenian dram. Online payments go through a licensed payment provider. Refunds are handled by the restaurant according to its rules and the law.

content.title: Reviews and content
content.body: Reviews must be honest and about a real visit. No insults, personal data of others, spam or advertising. We may hide content that breaks these rules. You keep rights to your content and allow us to show it on Spot. Restaurants may rate guests after a visit; these ratings must be fair and polite, and are shown only to that restaurant and the guest.

conduct.title: Fair use
conduct.body: Don't misuse the service: no attempts to break security, scrape data, place fake orders or bookings, or impersonate others.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We work hard to keep Spot available and correct, but the service is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses, or for the food and service provided by restaurants.

ending.title: Ending use
ending.body: You can stop using Spot and close your account at any time. We may end access for accounts that seriously or repeatedly break these terms.

law.title: Law and contact
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia. Questions? Write to {email}.
